title: Priced by names the source in words, not by colour
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with tier A on Markup % 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a category A part, line 1, and a second part with a typed price, line 2.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • Line 1's Priced by reads tier A's name in words.
  • Line 2's Priced by reads "Manual" in words beside its icon.
